brief_rationale: The model completed headache red-flag screening, identified high vascular risk, corrected the coronary/brain stent misunderstanding, classified medications by purpose with clear safety boundaries, addressed missing check results, formed a concrete follow-up plan including specialty and time frame, and obtained family teach-back on emergency triggers and medication non-self-adjustment. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error remains. Two case-defined high-order points (HO1 and HO3) were actively triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The closure is safe, executable, and traceable as valid_closure. Consequently, grade 4 (strong) is appropriate.
